knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: CL-R1
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Retrieve in order, one short phrase each: (1) parameter CI from a random sample; (2) prediction interval; (3) CI given a sampling distribution; (4) Normal mean and variance CIs; (5) binomial/Poisson CIs (Normal approx); (6) two-sample CIs; (7) paired mean-difference CI; (8) bootstrap confidence intervals.
